comment: Read from the maker's source at tag commit 7a96486 (v2.1.0), the installed version. The gain input multiplies rather than adds and there is no gain knob, so a cable carrying 0V into gain silences the module while an empty gain jack leaves the signal alone; that is in the entry because it looks like a broken module. The right shift takes the shift count straight from the voltage without fabs, unlike the left shift, so a negative voltage there gives a negative shift count, which C++ leaves undefined; nothing is claimed about what it does. The resolution figure of 128 is the tooltip value at the knob's maximum: configParam gives the knob a range of 0 to 10 and a display multiplier of maxRes, 12.8.
